name: deviload
description: Deviload — a clean Windows desktop front-end for yt-lp: paste a link, pick quality, download. Playlists,chapters, trim, GIF, one-click YouTube sign-in, RU/E.
readme_summary: Deviload is a clean, user-friendly desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux that simplifies downloading videos and audio from various online platforms. It leverages yt-dlp for robust downloading capabilities, offering features like playlist management, chapter splitting, GIF creation, and direct YouTube sign-in.
key_features: Downloads from YouTube and other yt-dlp supported sites
Supports various video and audio formats (MP4, MKV, WebM, MP3, FLAC, WAV)
One-click download with link preview (title, duration, streams)
Playlist management (whole list, ranges, chapter splitting)
Live stream recording with options for duration limits and daily repeats
Automatic downloads for watched channels and playlists
Follow artist feature for automatic album and single downloads
YouTube sign-in for personalized downloads
Multi-language support (English, Russian, Spanish)
primary_use_case: A desktop application for easily downloading and managing video and audio content from online sources, with a focus on YouTube.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot assistant holding a digital watering can, pouring streams of colorful data (representing videos and music) into a neatly organized digital garden. Each plant in the garden is a perfectly rendered album cover or video thumbnail. In the background, a subtle, glowing screen displays a simplified interface with a single input field for a URL and clear download quality options. The robot's eyes are bright and helpful, and the overall scene is clean, modern, and inviting, with a soft, digital glow. The name 'Deviload' is subtly integrated into a small signpost in the garden. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette.

name: CryptoClipGuard
readme_summary: CryptoClipGuard is a Python-based Windows utility that acts as a real-time clipboard monitor and protector. It specifically targets cryptocurrency users by detecting and preventing clipboard hijacking attacks, where malicious software attempts to replace copied crypto addresses with attacker-controlled ones.
key_features: Real-time clipboard monitoring
Detects BTC, ETH, SOL, and USDT (TRC20) addresses
Automatically blocks and reverts malicious clipboard replacements
Desktop notifications on hijack detection
Detailed logging
Runs silently in the system tray
primary_use_case: Protecting cryptocurrency users from clipboard hijacking malware by detecting and reverting malicious address replacements in real-time.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital guardian, represented by a stylized shield icon with a subtle circuit board pattern, stands watch over a digital clipboard. As a malicious red 'X' attempts to replace a golden cryptocurrency coin symbol with a corrupted one, the guardian's shield emits a protective blue wave, reverting the clipboard content back to the original golden coin. Small, glowing data streams flow from the clipboard to a system tray icon, indicating continuous monitoring. The background is a clean, abstract digital space with subtle code snippets and network lines. The overall mood is secure and protective, with a color palette of blues, golds, and subtle reds. Style: 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and clear visual indicators.

name: httptrafficmonitr
description: Windows desktop HTTP/HTTPS traffic monitor (MITM proxy, WPF) with an MCP server so AI assistants can inspect, filter, replay, and mock traffic
readme_summary: HTTP Traffic Monitor is a Windows desktop application that functions as a man-in-the-middle proxy for capturing, inspecting, and manipulating HTTP/HTTPS traffic. It features a WPF-based UI for detailed analysis and an MCP server interface for AI assistants to control and interact with the traffic data.
key_features: System-wide HTTP/HTTPS capture with TLS interception
Live request grid with filtering and search
Detailed request/response inspection tabs (Request, Response, Timing, Certificate, Decoded)
Advanced multi-condition filtering with saved presets
Request replay and composition
Request comparison with line-by-line diff
Rule-based alerting
Auto-Responder for mocking backend services
Live traffic and bandwidth graphs
Session saving/loading and export (CSV, HAR, JSON, cURL, Postman)
MCP server for AI assistant integration
primary_use_case: To capture, inspect, filter, replay, mock, and export HTTP/HTTPS traffic on Windows, with advanced control and automation capabilities for developers and AI assistants.
cover_image_prompt: A digital alchemist in a modern laboratory, meticulously examining streams of glowing data flowing from a computer monitor. The alchemist uses a magnifying glass to scrutinize individual data packets, which are represented as intricate, transparent orbs. Some orbs are being sorted into different vials labeled 'Request', 'Response', and 'Mock'. In the background, a subtle holographic interface displays network graphs and filter controls, with the 'HTTP Traffic Monitor' name subtly etched into the lab equipment. The overall mood is one of focused investigation and digital manipulation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic and vibrant, contrasting colors for data streams and UI elements.

name: hingewave
description: The iPhone Duo fold animation for MacBook lids, Windows laptops and Android foldables. One effect, three native apps, one-command install.
readme_summary: Hingewave is a cross-platform application that creates a dynamic fold animation effect for laptop lids and foldable devices. It synchronizes screen visuals with the physical hinge's angle, offering a unique aesthetic for macOS, Windows, and Android.
key_features: iPhone Duo fold animation effect
Cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Android)
Real-time synchronization with device hinge angle
GPU-accelerated rendering
One-command installation scripts
Live wallpaper functionality on Android
Shared effect definition across all ports
primary_use_case: To provide a visually engaging and interactive animation that mimics the folding motion of a device's lid or hinge on the screen, enhancing the user experience for laptops and foldables.
cover_image_prompt: A majestic, ancient book with a glowing, holographic spine lies open on a wooden desk. As the book's cover is gently closed, the pages within don't just fold, but the text and illustrations transform into a dynamic, flowing wave of digital particles that emanates from the hinge outwards, darkening and frosting as the cover seals. Small, subtle UI elements resembling a laptop's menu bar or a foldable phone's status bar are integrated into the scene. The overall mood is magical and technological, with a soft, ethereal glow emanating from the transforming pages. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual storytelling and a blend of fantasy and technology.
